name: CashPilot
description: CashPilot runs passive income services (bandwidth sharing, DePIN, storage and GPU compute) on your own server and shows what they earn in one web dashboard. A worker container starts the services that run in Docker; the dashboard reads the providers' balances into one earnings history.
short_desc: Run passive income services and see what they earn.
author: GeiserX

form_fields.label: Read-only API key (optional, for Home Assistant, Grafana or cashpilot-mcp)
Metrics token (optional, required as a Bearer token on /metrics)
